title: PRODUCT REVIEW: AIPAS M2 PRO E-BIKE!
description:
PRODUCT REVIEW: AIPAS M2 PRO E-BIKE! Today I am going to show this awesome e-bike from Aipas Bikes! The M2 Pro is a 26 inch 7-speed bike that features an 1800 watt motor capable of speeds of up to 36 MPH! In this video, I will show you all of the specs and details of this bike and take you for a little ride through the woods and on the road! Unlike other e-bikes, this one wont break the bank! This bike provides range of up to 85 miles on a single charge and with a comfortable seat and handle bars, you'll be ready to ride comfortably for miles to come!

Thank you to Aipas for making this happen! I really enjoy this bike!
